content.title: Lyft CEO David Risher Makes $100,000 Insider Stock Purchase
content.summary: Lyft  chief executive bought several thousand shares of the ride-hailing company last week, according to a securities filing.  CEO David Risher, who also serves as director of the board, purchased 5,926 shares of common stock for about $100,000 on Sept. 3, at a weighted average price of $16.875 apiece, according to a Form 4 filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.  The transaction brought Risher’s total holdings, including restricted stock units that will convert to common stock at a later date, to 11,797,266 shares.

content.title: Robotaxi Battle Heats Up With Amazon's Las Vegas Zoox Launch, Lyft's Atlanta Expansion
content.summary: Zoox, Amazon's robotaxi subsidiary, said Wednesday that it's now offering rides in Las Vegas.  Amazon stock was lower on a day that also saw Lyft expand its autonomous offerings.  The Amazon robotaxi service is offering free rides along the Las Vegas strip in its boxy Zoox cabs, with plans to expand throughout the city and begin charging for rides after "the necessary regulatory approval," according to a news release. The tech giant acquired Zoox in 2020 for $1.2 billion and has been testing its technology in Las Vegas and San Francisco in recent months.
